title: Learning Autoregressive Neural Operators on Solver-Defined Physical Constraint Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2611.19753v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive neural operators approximate time-dependent PDE solvers by repeatedly composing a learned transition, although the resulting states need not remain feasible under the discrete constraints of the numerical problem. We study this issue for incompressible flow, where each velocity state must satisfy solver-level incompressibility together with prescribed boundary values. We formulate autoregressive operator learning as a map between solver-defined affine feasible sets and introduce PCM-NO, a projected-residual realization of this feasible-transition principle. The neural backbone predicts a candidate state increment, a fixed tangent projection extracts its admissible component, and a metric retraction maps the advanced state to the prescribed feasible set. translated_title: 在求解器定义的物理约束流形上学习自回归神经算子
translated_abstract: 自回归神经算子通过反复组合学习到的转移算子来近似时间相关的偏微分方程（PDE）求解器，但由此产生的状态在数值问题的离散约束下未必保持可行。我们针对不可压缩流研究了这一问题，其中每个速度状态必须同时满足求解器层面的不可压缩性约束和给定的边界值。我们将自回归算子学习表述为求解器定义的仿射可行集之间的映射，并提出了 PCM-NO——这一可行转移原理的投影残差实现。其神经骨干网络预测候选状态增量，固定的切向投影提取出可采纳分量，度量回缩则将推进后的状态映射到指定的可行集上。通过精确的仿射约束求解，所得的转移在可行集上是封闭的，同时一个仿射恒等式将可采纳更新参数化与稳……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出PCM-NO方法，通过“预测增量—切向投影—度量回缩”的投影残差机制，保证自回归神经算子每一步预测都严格落在满足不可压缩性与边界条件的求解器可行集上，实现物理约束流形上的封闭状态转移。
en_tdlr: Proposes PCM-NO, a projected-residual autoregressive neural operator whose predict-project-retract design guarantees every state update remains strictly feasible on solver-defined constraint manifolds of incompressibility and boundary conditions.
